entityDescription:
Icebreaker One focuses on bridging the gaps between finance, policy and climate — unlocking a data marketplace that will help better inform large-scale financial decisions to minimise their carbon and environmental impact. 

Our ability to join up and use existing and emerging data to address our environmental crises is stifled. The inhibitor to innovation is not technology— it is culture. Asset owners, funders and insurers are complex value chains today: not working with data at-scale due to high transaction costs. 

We have an ocean of available capital. Lack of good data-flow is leading to misallocation of resources, missed opportunities and catastrophic risks on our global balance sheets. Broad digital transformation is reaching maturity across industries—now is the time to build in new uses for the data. If we solve this for climate change, we will unlock solutions for other areas.

Building multi-disciplinary partnerships, based on decades of experience with open standards, data governance, mass collaboration, and public-private partnerships, Icebreaker One will unlock the exchange of decision-critical data to enable a multi-trillion dollar shift in investment.

entityDescription:
Company AXIS TECH was founded in 2010 as a Czech company focused on production of precise machining. Through strong investments we achieved very good production technologies supported with know-how from aerospace and space industry. Currently we have 45 employees and we are in SME range.

We are qualified according to ISO 9001:2015. In our ISO certification are implemented aerospace requirements including FAI procedure.

Our core business is production of precise milled parts up to one meter made mainly from titanium and aluminium alloys, stainless steels, plastic materials and hardened materials as well.

For surface treatments, NDT and production of bigger parts are used qualified subsuppliers in Czech republic or in EU countries.
We can offer not only deliveries of parts but also assembly including final adjustment.

Actually we have 1 800 m2 of production area size with ten 5-axis CNC-Machines HERMLE and one 3-axis CNC-Machine ZPS. For turning and grinding are installed conventional machines.

For deburring we have two areas, first one is for deburring according to standard conditions, second one is for precise deburring and cleaning of parts under the microscope.

Inspection room is fully air-conditioned with three CMM machines, the largest one is up to two meters.

Since founding is our company as qualified supplier of structural parts for Airbus, Boeing and Embraer aircrafts.

For space industry we deliver mainly precise parts for telecommunication and meteorological satellites and MGSE as well.
Production of spacer for satellite separation device (customer S.A.B. Aerospace).

It was created through parliamentary decree in 1912, passed by the 15th National Assembly. It contributes not only to the formation of the officer corps, but also to the construction of the new Bulgarian state in the spirit of European values. RNDC is a leading national educational institution with many years of tradition in higher education for the training and education of officers and students in various master's specialties. It offers modern academic training combined with leadership and civic responsibility in security and defense.

NEDERLANDSE ONDERZOEKSCHOOL VOOR ASTRONOMIE NOVA)

(Netherlands Research School for Astronomy)

NOVA is the federation of the astronomical institutes at the universities of Amsterdam, Groningen , Leiden and Nijmegen, legally represented by University Leiden.

Nova's mission is two-fold:

* To carry out front-line astronomical research in the Netherlands

* To train young astronomers at the highest international level
